label: Underived necessary concretum, from necessity, no contingent support and coverage
meaning: An alternative to the stage-one join NecessaryConcreteUnderivedFromNecessity.underived that replaces reflexive access and J2 (well-founded cross-world union) by well-founded actual grounding at w and coverage. From a necessary concretum, descend actual grounding among concreta existing at w and necessary from w: a supporter of such a concretum at any admitted world gives, by coverage, a concrete supporter existing at w, which J1 (used only at w) makes necessary, so a minimal one has no existing concrete supporter at any admitted world. The witness may differ from the given necessary concretum. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.

This interface is retained for comparison with its original proof path; the weak version, the closed-collection condition (registered strengthens, strict by ClosedGroundingRoots Control.limitGrounder), suffices: ClosedGroundingRoots.underivedFromNecessityOfCoverageClosed proves the same endpoint from the same premises with it in place of well-founded actual grounding. That reduction establishes none of the remaining premises.
